newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mid-Atlantic spot power firms on gas, weather.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mid-Atlantic spot power firms on gas, weather.

text.p: Spot bulk electricity prices in the Mid-Atlantic U.S. firmed Friday on a jump in natural gas prices and forecasts of weather cooling over the weekend.
"Gas is higher. There's some bad weather next week," said a East Coast broker.
Saturday's expected return of the 1,055 megawatt (MW) Limerick 2 nuclear power unit pressured prices lower in early trading, market sources said.
Forecasts of higher Monday demand in the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) Interconnect district helped spot prices to rebound from their early lows, they said.
"It's not going to be big deal," said a PJM trader, referring to Limerick 2's restart.
The Pottstown, Pa., generating plant, operated by PECO Energy Co, was shut Tuesday to repair to an oil leak in the turbine's hydraulic control system.

In the U.S. Gulf, the source of natural gas for the East Coast, spot deliveries on average rose 20 cents per million British thermal units today. On the New York Mercantile Exchange, January Henry Hub gas futures rallied 19.1 cents to $3.725 in midday trading.
Firm, peak PJM electricity for Monday was quoted at $25.50-$26.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) with deals heard done at $24.75-$25.75.
Today's quote was higher than Thursday's $24.75-$25.25 for Friday delivery.
Firm, peak PJM deliveries for Saturday and Sunday were offered at $21.00 and $20.50.
Firm, off-peak PJM electricity for Monday was assessed at $15.00-$16.00, up from Thursday's $14.50-$15.50.
Firm, off-peak PJM deliveries for Saturday and Sunday were offered at $16.50.
PJM power deliveries for the balance of December were assessed at $26.25-$26.75 with transaction changing hands at $26.50. Today's range compared with Thursday's $26.50 quote.
January/February 1997 PJM electricity was pegged at $30.85-$31.05 with deals heard done at $30.85-$31.00. Today's range compared with $30.60-$30.70 Thursday.
Deferred PJM electricity prices were mostly unchanged from Thursday, brokers and marketers said.
March PJM deliveries stood at $25.25-$25.70. First-quarter 1997 PJM was discussed at $29.00-$29.40, up from Thursday's $28.80-$28.90. Second-quarter PJM stayed at $23.20-$23.35.

July/August 1997 PJM power edged lower to $31.75-$32.00 from Thursday's $31.90-$32.35. Third-quarter 1997 PJM was still in the $28.75-$29.10 area, and fourth-quarter 1997 PJM remained at $24.00-$24.50.
Calendar 1997 for peak hour delivery in PJM continued to thinly discussed at $26.30-$26.60.
